content:
alex_k: Heads up — vendor says they can split the H200 shipment but require staging at FRA warehouse for customs clearance. Need to confirm lead time + extra AWB fees. Anyone on procurement loop?

samir: Can we push some units to us-west as fallback if FRA holds? What's the vendor lead time delta?

morgan_ops: FRA staging adds ~48-72h for customs processing in eu -> could be 3–4 days total. Also dock queue at FRA is ~1 day. :truck: 

jess_prod: If staging pushes >5 days we should swap to US pool for critical queues. Which units are flexible?

alex_k: 6 units in priority pool (prod inference). 4 units can be delayed. 2 need fast replacement.

lia_procure: Vendor update: split OK, but split incurs extra AWB + handling: EUR 1,200 per AWB (est). They require PO amendment for the fee and a separate RMA AWB for returns. Need signoff.

alex_k: rough math — +€2.4k on AWB. Can we absorb cost or bill vendor credit? Ops impact?

morgan_ops: Cost might be on procurement. But delaying weekly burn reduces spot spend. Tradeoff.

lia_procure: Vendor also flagged firmware mismatch risk for mixed batch — they can preflash at depot for €300/unit. Options?

jess_prod: Preflash preferred for prod units. Approve up to €600 total?

samir: Approve preflash for the 2 critical units. Rest we accept as-is but require serial manifest.

alex_k: @lia_procure please update PO and push amendment. Also need AWB manifest snippet for logistic team:
```
AWB: 123-FR-98765 
Items: H200 x6 (S/N list attached)
Staging: FRA depot 3
RMA: separate AWB when return happens
```

lia_procure: On it. Asking vendor for exact ETA — they quoted 7 business days from pickup if FRA holds, 4 days if direct air to US.

procurement_bot: PR #5421 updated: PO amendment created, awaiting approver (lia_procure).

jess_prod: If vendor gives 4 days to US, we can route 2 critical to US and 4 to FRA. Any objections?

morgan_ops: Need to confirm customs HS code for temporary import to EU. If HS mismatch we get hold. Lia, can vendor confirm HS?

lia_procure: Asked vendor. They replied: HS code 8471.80, but forwarder warned classification risk. If reclass we may see duty hold.

alex_k: Ok — proceed with split plan but add contingency: expedite air re-route if FRA hold >48h. @lia_procure please request expedited AWB pricing and update PO with cap €5k for emergency air.

lia_procure: Will request now.

jess_prod: Thanks. I'll flag on the console routes so traffic shifts if capacity is delayed.

samir: Tagging infra-sre for routing policy change if units late: @infra-sre

morgan_ops: Note: staging node tag for those serials should be set to "staged-fra" so auto-routing picks them.

alex_k: closing loop — lia, ping when PO amended & vendor confirms AWB + preflash charges.

lia_procure: Will update in thread once vendor confirms. :thumbsup:
